svg.title: Figure 1 · Standards applicability
svg.desc: Every standard the framework names with its status
svg.text: The 18 standards the framework names and how each is used. Status is a project choice, not a contractual applicability or a certification
claim; only MIL-STD-882E is encoded as data and checked.
Integrated walker/UAV/GSE safety program; modeled as data in standards/mil-std-882e/model.yaml, tailored in
Walker mechanical hazards and risk reduction
Functional safety lifecycle and E/E/PE control methods
SUS-A1 FHA, PSSA, SSA, FMEA, FTA and CCA
Software safety tasks behind the MIL-STD-882E 4.4 level of rigor for each SwCI (lead decision DQ-030); mapped
Airborne software and electronic hardware assurance
Tool qualification or applicable software supplements
Military airworthiness criteria if required by authority
Techniques only if a suitable vehicle/autonomy use case is defined
Generated by tools/figures/framework_readme.py from the framework pages, the MIL-STD-882E tailoring and task records. Project-defined framework; no gate has passed and no compliance is claimed.

g.text: Terms: ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A = SAE guidelines for the safety assessment process on civil aircraft · AS9100 = aerospace quality
management standard · CCA = common cause analysis · DO-178C = RTCA software considerations in airborne systems · DO-254 = RTCA design assurance for airborne electronic hardware · DO-330 =
RTCA software tool qualification considerations · DoD = US Department of Defense · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · EIA = Electronic Industries
Alliance · EIA-649 = SAE / EIA configuration management standard · EMI = electromagnetic interference · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) ·
FMEA = failure modes and effects analysis · FTA = fault tree analysis · IEC = International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC 61508 functional safety) · ISO = International Organization for
Standardization (ISO 12100 machinery risk, ISO 13849 control safety, ISO 26262 road vehicles) · JSSSEH-IG = Joint Software Systems Safety Engineering Handbook Implementation Guide, the guide
for the software safety tasks behind each level of rigor (DQ-030) · MIL-HDBK-516 = US DoD airworthiness certification criteria handbook · MIL-STD-1472 = US DoD design criteria for human
engineering · MIL-STD-461 = US DoD electromagnetic interference requirements · MIL-STD-810H = US DoD environmental engineering test methods · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for
System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · NIST = US National Institute of Standards and Technology · PSSA = preliminary system safety assessment (ARP4761A) · RTCA = RTCA, Inc., publisher
of DO-178C and DO-254 · SAE = SAE International, publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SP = Special Publication (NIST) · SSA = system safety assessment (ARP4761A) · SUS-A1 = dockable
observation UAV · SwCI = software criticality index (MIL-STD-882E Table V) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
